design_detail: Systematic review and meta-analysis of neuropsychological studies comparing methamphetamine users with non-users; pooled effect sizes by cognitive domain.
can_establish: The average size and consistency of group differences across published studies, by domain.
cannot_establish: Whether the differences are caused by methamphetamine; whether they are clinically meaningful for an individual.
